circadian.title: Circadian Rhythm
circadian.description: Your 24-hour hormonal cycle. Testosterone peaks in the morning and gradually declines throughout the day.

infradian.title: Infradian Rhythm
infradian.description: Your longer hormonal cycle spanning roughly 20-30 days. Similar to how women have monthly cycles, men experience fluctuations in testosterone and other hormones.

premium_required: Upgrade to Premium to see your full cycle analysis and historical trends.
not_enough_data: Keep logging daily to see your cycle patterns. We need at least 14 days of data.
